resources.string:
Privacy and data

This app stores the blood pressure values and measurement times you enter, together with record identifiers, in Google Firebase Firestore under your Firebase account. Firestore keeps a local cache to support offline use. Google sign-in uses your Google account identity; guest sign-in creates an anonymous Firebase account.

Camera and gallery

You can take a photo with the system camera or select an image using the system photo picker. The selected image is processed on your device to recognize numbers and is not uploaded by this app. Camera photos are temporarily stored in private cache and removed after processing or cancellation; interrupted captures may remain until cache is cleared. Gallery originals are not changed. Recognized values fill the inputs automatically; check them before saving. Google ML Kit collects device and app information, installation identifiers, performance metrics, and recognition event diagnostics for SDK operation and usage analysis. These diagnostics do not include the selected images.

Health Connect

Copying readings to Health Connect is optional and requires your permission. The app requests write access to blood pressure records; it does not read your Health Connect history. Turning copying off stops future writes. Existing copies remain until you remove them. Saving an edited reading updates its linked copy when copying is enabled. Older copies created by earlier app versions may not be linked.

Analytics and advertising

The app does not include Firebase Analytics or advertising integrations. It does not request location access. Firebase Authentication and Firestore process network and service information needed to provide account and storage services.

Your choices

Use Account and settings to export CSV, delete cloud readings, or delete your account and cloud readings. Exported files remain wherever you saved or shared them. Manage Health Connect copies and permissions in Health Connect settings. Local cache is cleared when you clear app storage or uninstall; removing cloud records is a separate action. Device backups of app data are disabled.

Guest accounts

Guest access cannot be recovered after signing out, clearing app storage, or reinstalling. Link a Google account before doing so, or export your readings. If your Google account already belongs to another account, export your guest history before switching.

About readings

This app records values from your monitor. It does not measure blood pressure or provide a diagnosis.
